## Agents (MCP)

- MCP endpoint (agents): mcp.methodex.fyi — 13 tools over Streamable-HTTP MCP. Point your LLM at this endpoint and query methodology directly; the killer query is a tool: get_methodology. The transport requires the header `Accept: text/event-stream`, so a plain browser GET returns 406 by design — this is a machine endpoint, not a web page.
- MCP connection snippet: https://methodex.fyi/code
